rationale: Colin's deep expertise in AI infrastructure, multi-agent systems, and developer relations directly complements Sankeerth's work building practical AI agents at Agentin AI. Colin has hands-on experience with agentic AI tooling and understands the inference infrastructure requirements that production agent systems need—exactly the gap between research and deployment that Sankeerth is solving. They could explore how Nebius's GPU cloud infrastructure and Colin's ecosystem-building approach (via Dabl.Club) might accelerate Agentin AI's developer adoption.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Sankeerth Rao Karingula—you're both focused on making agentic AI practical, and Colin's infrastructure expertise and developer community at Dabl.Club could be a natural fit for Agentin AI's go-to-market.
